meta.name: story-deslop
meta.description: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把AI味文字改回自然网文,读起来像真人写的
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果是写网文却总被说‘太AI’的创作者
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite AI-flavored prose so web novels read naturally human
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels but keep getting told your text feels AI-generated

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检测文本里的 AI 写作痕迹（禁用词、套路句式、心理告知、均匀节奏、解释腔等），判定轻度/中度/重度，并按要求改写为更自然口语的网文风格；也可以只检测不改写。
howto.when: 当你说“去AI味”“这篇太AI了”等话，或使用 /story-deslop 等命令时触发；贴文要求“润色/检查AI味”也会接手。

say.text: 这段话太AI了，帮我改成自然网文风格。
say.note: 会先出检测报告再逐句改写。

say.text: 把这段重写一下，去去AI味，保留剧情。
say.note: 按门禁规则改写并给润色报告。

say.text: 只检测这段有没有AI味，不要改动。
say.note: 只输出检测报告，不改原文。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude detects AI-writing artifacts (banned words, formulaic patterns, told emotions, uniform rhythm, authorial explanation), rates severity, and rewrites toward natural, colloquial web-fiction prose; it can detect only.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like “去AI味”/“这篇太AI了” or commands like /story-deslop; also when you paste text asking to polish or check for AI flavor.

say_en.text: This passage sounds too AI; rewrite it in a natural web-novel style.
say_en.note: Runs detection and rewrites sentence by sentence.

say_en.text: Rewrite this to remove AI flavor, keep the plot intact.
say_en.note: Applies gate rules and outputs a polishing report.

say_en.text: Only check if this has AI flavor; don't change it.
say_en.note: Outputs detection report only; no edits.
